start: bash -c 'cd /app && npx prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma 2>/dev/null; npx prisma db push --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss 2>/dev/null; export API_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001; echo Starting NestJS API...; cd apps/api && node dist/main.js & API_PID=$!; echo Waiting for API on port 3001...; for i in $(seq 1 45); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo API ready! && break; sleep 1; done; cd /app/apps/web && npx next start -H 0.0.0.0'
